seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in La Habra, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in La Habra, California for 2026: the Tamale Festival tree lighting, Breakfast with Santa and A Charlie Brown Christmas.
lede: La Habra's Christmas peaks on December 5 with the Tamale Festival and its tree lighting, then moves to Breakfast with Santa and Charlie Brown at the Depot Theatre.
celebrates: La Habra's Christmas season peaks on Saturday, December 5, when the city's 13th Annual Tamale Festival adds a holiday tree lighting, a Holiday Firework show, two Kid Zones with pony rides and carnival games, and photos with Santa. A week later, The Children's Museum at La Habra hosts Breakfast with Santa at the Community Center on December 12, with a sensory friendly first session. The Phantom Projects Theatre at La Habra Depot presents A Charlie Brown Christmas from December 4 to 20, a 30 minute family show.
lastyear: The Tamale Festival's website lists 2025 food and general vendors, which shows the festival ran again last year, and its home page says the first festival was held in 2014 and now draws about 10,000 people each year. A La Habra city calendar entry from 2019 says the city's Christmas tree lighting takes place as part of the festival at 5:30 pm, so the tree lighting has been part of the day for years. The theatre's Charlie Brown Christmas page was first published in December 2022.
facts: The Phantom Projects Theatre's page says the venue reopened after six months of renovations as The Phantom Projects Theatre at La Habra Depot. It is at 311 S Euclid St, close to The Children's Museum at La Habra at 301 S Euclid St and the festival's Brio Park Kid Zone at 300 S Euclid St, so downtown families can walk between them on festival day. The festival also runs a free shuttle from off site parking.
trains: La Habra's Depot Theatre is housed in the La Habra Depot, but no train rides are listed for La Habra this Christmas. Families looking for a ride can try the City of Cypress Holiday Sing and Tree Lighting on December 1, which lists train rides, or Irvine Park Railroad in Orange, whose site says Santa's Village runs from November 27 to December 30. Our Anaheim guide also covers Holidays at the Disneyland Resort.
traditions: The city's all day festival with three stages, tamales, a tree lighting and fireworks.
The city's Christmas tree lighting, held as part of the Tamale Festival.
Pony rides, carnival games, cookie decorating and Santa photos at City Hall.
A Children's Museum at La Habra breakfast with a sensory friendly session.
A 30 minute family play at the La Habra Depot Theatre.
kidfact: At the La Habra Tamale Festival, kids can ride a pony, see Santa and watch fireworks on the same day.
faq: What is the biggest Christmas event in La Habra?
The La Habra Tamale Festival on Saturday, December 5, 2026, which includes a holiday tree lighting, a Holiday Firework show and Kids Zones, according to the festival's website.
How much is the Kids Zone?
Wristbands are $20 presale or $25 on the day, and single activity tickets are $5. Some items, such as face painting and the petting zoo, are free.
Can kids have breakfast with Santa in La Habra?
Yes. The Children's Museum at La Habra hosts Breakfast with Santa on December 12, with a sensory friendly 8 am session, at $25 per adult and $20 per child.
Where can we see A Charlie Brown Christmas in La Habra?
At The Phantom Projects Theatre at La Habra Depot, 311 S Euclid St, December 4 to 20, with no show on December 5.
Are there train rides in La Habra?
None are listed in La Habra. The City of Cypress lists train rides at its Holiday Sing on December 1.
sources: Season Calendar at La Habra Depot
